data.one_liner: Check device internet connection and listen to status changes.
data.what_it_does: Simple Connection Checker allows developers to verify if a device is connected to the internet. It provides both a static method for a one-time check and a stream-based method to listen for connection status changes over time.
use_when: You need to quickly check if the device has an active internet connection.
You want to listen to real-time changes in internet connectivity status.
avoid_when: You need detailed network interface information (like Wi-Fi vs cellular details), which is not documented as a feature.
You require a well-established official connectivity library without custom lookup mechanisms.
strengths: Provides a simple static method to check internet connection instantly.
Includes a stream to listen for connection changes.
Allows specifying a custom lookup address.
weaknesses: Relies on HTTP lookups which might introduce slight latency or battery overhead compared to native connectivity hooks.
Limited documentation regarding comprehensive platform-specific nuances.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a more comprehensive and widely-used alternative for checking network connectivity status across platforms.
